title: Stop Paying Extra Zoho Books Seats for Bill Approvals #Shorts

angle.problem: Vendor bill approvals require purchasing expensive additional user licenses in Zoho Books just for approval workflows.
angle.solution: Automate bill approval notifications with actionable webhook links via Deluge, updating approval status without extra user seats.
steps: Create a custom field named 'Approval Status' in Zoho Books Bill preferences.
Set up a Workflow Rule on Bill creation that triggers a Deluge script sending an email with action links.
Use a Zoho Flow webhook link to receive the approval response and update the bill status via Zoho Books API.
angle.result: Save software subscription costs by approving vendor bills without paying for extra Zoho Books licenses.
angle.hook: Paying full Zoho Books license fees just to approve bills?

story.title: How I cut a property management firm's software costs by changing one workflow
story.summary: When I looked at how property management companies handle bills, I found a quiet money leak. It wasn't fraud or bad investments. It was software licensing. The standard workflow: Property Manager logs into Zoho Books to upload a bill. L1 Manager logs into Zoho Books to approve it. Finance Manager logs into Zoho Books to finalize it. The issue: Zoho Books charges a plan fee per organisation, which includes a fixed number of users (3 to 15 depending on the plan). Every user beyond that costs about ₹150–180 per month, plus GST. Say you have 20 properties. That's Let's say 30 (25(pr) + (1-3)(L1) + (1-2)(fin)) people who need a login just to upload or click "Approve". That pushes you into a higher plan and adds extra seats on top.
